# Simplified invoices (SIM)

When a simplified invoice (F2) may replace a full one, what it must carry and what it can never document.

Rules page: https://docs.beel.es/rules/simplified

"Checked by: Your integration" or "The issuing business" means BeeL. does not enforce the rule, beyond any error codes it lists: the integration has to.

## SIM-001

**A simplified invoice never exceeds 3,000 €**

`MUST NOT` · Law · Impact: critical · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

Do not issue a simplified invoice whose total, VAT included, is above 3,000 €, whatever the activity. Above it, issue a standard invoice (F1) with the customer identified.

**Why:** The law allows a simplified invoice up to that amount only for the activities of art. 4.2, and AEAT rejects an F2 record above it.

**Applies to:** invoice types `SIMPLIFIED`; operations `createCompanyInvoice`, `patchCompanyInvoice`, `issueCompanyInvoice`

**Error codes:** [`SIMPLIFIED_INVOICE_EXCEEDS_LEGAL_LIMIT`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/SIMPLIFIED_INVOICE_EXCEEDS_LEGAL_LIMIT)

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 4.2 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a4
- AEAT, Validaciones y errores VERI*FACTU (v1.2.2), 3.1.3.15.8 — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/Validaciones_Errores_Veri-Factu.pdf

**Incorrect:** A simplified invoice with one line of 2,600 € at 21 % VAT: it totals 3,146 € and the API answers SIMPLIFIED_INVOICE_EXCEEDS_LEGAL_LIMIT.

**Correct:** The same sale as a standard invoice, with the customer's NIF or alternative_id.

**Related:** SIM-002, SIM-006

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#the-decision-in-one-table · https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#on-the-f2-path

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/SIM-001.md

## SIM-002

**Above 400 €, a simplified invoice needs an art. 4.2 activity**

`MUST NOT` · Law · Impact: high · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Do not issue a simplified invoice above 400 €, VAT included, unless the operation is one of those listed in art. 4.2 (retail sales, hospitality, passenger transport and the rest of the list) or the invoice is a corrective.

**Why:** Outside art. 4.2 the law only allows a simplified invoice up to that amount; above it the operation needed a full invoice.

**Applies to:** invoice types `SIMPLIFIED`

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 4.1 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a4

**Incorrect:** A consultancy issuing a 900 € simplified invoice to a private client.

**Correct:** A restaurant issuing a 900 € simplified invoice for a group dinner: hospitality is in the art. 4.2 list.

**Related:** SIM-001, SIM-009

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#the-decision-in-one-table

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/SIM-002.md

## SIM-003

**Some operations can never go on a simplified invoice**

`MUST NOT` · Law · Impact: high · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. rejects the cases listed under the error codes; the rest is yours to check.

Do not document on a simplified invoice the operations of art. 4.4, such as intra-EU supplies of goods exempt under art. 25 LIVA. The API rejects intra-EU and OSS operations and reverse charge on a simplified invoice and, as BeeL.'s own rule, also equivalence surcharge and IRPF withholding.

**Why:** These operations need an identified recipient, whether to exempt, to shift the tax to the customer or to withhold, and a simplified invoice has none.

**Applies to:** invoice types `SIMPLIFIED`; operations `createCompanyInvoice`, `patchCompanyInvoice`

**Error codes:** [`SIMPLIFICADA_FORBIDS_CROSS_BORDER`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/SIMPLIFICADA_FORBIDS_CROSS_BORDER), [`SIMPLIFICADA_FORBIDS_ISP`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/SIMPLIFICADA_FORBIDS_ISP), [`SIMPLIFICADA_FORBIDS_SURCHARGE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/SIMPLIFICADA_FORBIDS_SURCHARGE), [`SIMPLIFICADA_FORBIDS_IRPF`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/SIMPLIFICADA_FORBIDS_IRPF)

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 4.4 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a4

**Incorrect:** A simplified invoice for goods shipped to a company in France under the intra-EU exemption: the API answers SIMPLIFICADA_FORBIDS_CROSS_BORDER.

**Correct:** A standard invoice identifying the French company by its VAT number.

**Related:** SIM-006, TAX-004, TAX-003, SUR-001

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#operations-where-f2-is-not-allowed · https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#why-no-irpf-on-f2

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/SIM-003.md

## SIM-004

**A simplified invoice still carries its minimum contents**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

A simplified invoice carries its number and series, issue date, the operation date when different, the issuer's NIF and name, what was sold, the tax rate and the total. BeeL. fills in the issuer's data from the company profile; each line needs a description and its main tax.

**Why:** Simplified does not mean empty: without these details the ticket is not a valid invoice.

**Applies to:** invoice types `SIMPLIFIED`; operations `createCompanyInvoice`, `issueCompanyInvoice`

**Error codes:** [`LINE_NORMAL_DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/LINE_NORMAL_DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED), [`LINE_MAIN_TAX_REQUIRED`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/LINE_MAIN_TAX_REQUIRED), [`PROFILE_INCOMPLETE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/PROFILE_INCOMPLETE)

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 7.1.d)–g) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a7

**Incorrect:** A simplified invoice whose only line has no description: the API answers LINE_NORMAL_DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED.

**Correct:** The same line with a description of what was sold and its VAT rate.

**Related:** SIM-008, NUM-005

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#on-the-f2-path

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/SIM-004.md

## SIM-005

**The record of a simplified invoice carries no recipient**

`MUST NOT` · AEAT criterion · Impact: low · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. does this for you.

The billing record of a simplified invoice (F2) or of its corrective (R5) carries no recipient, while F1 and R1–R4 records carry at least one. BeeL. never sends recipient data in an F2 or R5 record.

**Why:** AEAT rejects an F2 or R5 record with recipients, and an F1 without them.

**Applies to:** invoice types `SIMPLIFIED`, `CORRECTIVE`; VeriFactu enabled; F2 and R5 records.

**Legal basis:**

- AEAT, Validaciones y errores VERI*FACTU (v1.2.2), 3.1.3.13 Agrupación Destinatarios — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/Validaciones_Errores_Veri-Factu.pdf

**Incorrect:** Expecting the customer's name on a simplified invoice to reach AEAT.

**Correct:** Issuing a standard invoice when the customer has to be identified to AEAT.

**Related:** SIM-006, REC-001

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#on-the-f2-path · https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/what-aeat-receives

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/SIM-005.md

## SIM-006

**An identified customer gets a standard invoice (F1)**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: high · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

When a business customer asks for its NIF and address on the invoice, or a consumer needs them to exercise a tax right, the invoice identifies the recipient and shows the tax separately, and AEAT registers it as F1. In BeeL. issue it as a standard invoice: a simplified invoice takes no identified recipient.

**Why:** A simplified invoice that identifies its recipient is a qualified one, registered as F1; an F2 record cannot carry the recipient.

**Applies to:** invoice types `SIMPLIFIED`, `STANDARD`; operations `createCompanyInvoice`, `patchCompanyInvoice`

**Error codes:** [`SIMPLIFIED_INVOICE_FORBIDS_IDENTIFIED_RECIPIENT`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/SIMPLIFIED_INVOICE_FORBIDS_IDENTIFIED_RECIPIENT)

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 7.2 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a7
- AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU, Procedimientos de facturación: Tipo de facturas — https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/iva/sistemas-informaticos-facturacion-verifactu/preguntas-frecuentes/procedimientos-facturacion.html

**Incorrect:** A simplified invoice whose recipient carries the customer's nif: the API answers SIMPLIFIED_INVOICE_FORBIDS_IDENTIFIED_RECIPIENT.

**Correct:** A standard invoice with the customer's NIF, name and address, whatever the amount.

**Related:** SIM-005, SIM-009, CNT-005

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#on-the-f2-path · https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#on-the-f1-path

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/SIM-006.md

## SIM-007

**Exchanging a simplified invoice for a full one**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

An invoice issued in exchange for earlier simplified invoices is not a corrective. AEAT registers it as F3, identifying the invoices it replaces, or as F1 when the simplified invoice was first credited. BeeL. issues the full invoice as a standard invoice (F1) after an R5 TOTAL corrective on the simplified one.

**Why:** The exchange documents the same sale again with the customer identified; the simplified invoice has to be offset so the sale is not counted twice.

**Applies to:** invoice types `SIMPLIFIED`, `CORRECTIVE`, `STANDARD`; operations `createCompanyCorrectiveInvoice`, `createCompanyInvoice`

**Decides:**

- *The customer asks for a full invoice with their details in place of a simplified one already issued.* → Issue an R5 TOTAL corrective on the simplified invoice, then a new standard invoice with the customer's data.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 15.6 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a15
- AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU, Procedimientos de facturación: factura en sustitución de simplificadas — https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/iva/sistemas-informaticos-facturacion-verifactu/preguntas-frecuentes/procedimientos-facturacion.html

**Incorrect:** Issuing a standard invoice for the same sale and leaving the simplified invoice as it was: the sale is invoiced twice.

**Correct:** Cancelling the simplified invoice with an R5 TOTAL corrective, then issuing the standard invoice.

```json
{ "rectification_type": "TOTAL", "rectification_code": "R5", "reason": "Customer asked for an invoice with its details" }
```

**Related:** SIM-009, COR-002, COR-013

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#upgrading-an-f2-to-f1-the-canje-case · https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/corrective-invoices#scenario-5--r5-cancelling-an-f2-to-issue-a-proper-f1

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/SIM-007.md

## SIM-008

**A simplified invoice carries the same legal mentions as a full one**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

When they apply, a simplified invoice carries the same mentions as a full invoice: the exemption, the special regime or the other mentions of art. 6.1 j) to p).

**Why:** The mention is what tells the reader why the invoice charges no tax or follows a special regime; a ticket is not exempt from it.

**Applies to:** invoice types `SIMPLIFIED`

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 7.1.i) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a7

**Incorrect:** A ticket for an exempt service that states neither the exemption nor its legal basis.

**Correct:** The same ticket with the line's exemption reason, so the invoice cites the exempting article.

**Related:** SIM-004, CNT-010

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/SIM-008.md

## SIM-009

**A customer who needs a full invoice is entitled to one**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

When the recipient is a business acting as such, or asks for an invoice to exercise a tax right, issue a full invoice with its details, even if you would otherwise hand out a simplified one.

**Why:** The law obliges the issuer to invoice in these cases; a ticket without the customer's details does not let it deduct the tax.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 2.2.a) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a2

**Incorrect:** Refusing a company its own invoice because the till only prints tickets.

**Correct:** Issuing a standard invoice with the company's NIF and address, or exchanging the ticket for one.

**Related:** SIM-006, SIM-007, CNT-002

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#upgrading-an-f2-to-f1-the-canje-case

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/SIM-009.md
